title: Fix replay of helper allocations above the single-width limit
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Two overlapping helpers of width `10^60` each produce a valid capacity-`2 * 10^60` allocation, but the separate `--verify` CLI rejects the emitted certificate with `integer token exceeds magnitude 10^60`. PR #5763's large-width test covered the API, while its CLI replay fixture used small widths.

Use a certificate-only integer reader bounded by `512 * 10^60`, the largest pool the existing input schema permits. Check token length before integer conversion. Lifetime inputs retain their original bounds, and the occupancy, peak lower-bound and input-hash checks remain intact.

This is a tooling repair with no new kappa, supplier admission, changed mathematical hypotheses, or selected-frontier change. Maintainer review and hosted CI remain outstanding.

## Task and overlap

Started from canonical main `19fdb086ea96af9a9f87936a2b888e10af4ed810`, priority revision 8, and refreshed before submission. The upstream head is unchanged. This addresses the independent tool-interface review handoff in [Discussion #5752](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5752), surfaced through #1166. The `portable-replay` card (scope key `831cc1a3c8f9ff01b197`) is refined to this certificate serialization round-trip failure, rather than an environment mismatch.

The concrete object is the helper allocator's emitted JSON certificate, within its existing domain of at most 512 lifetimes, width at most `10^60`, and endpoints at most `10^12`. The predecessor is [PR #5763](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5763), head `cee2336bc3a20c586b1dbb55152d97a114c657a6`, already incorporated into main. This adds independent CLI regression evidence and repairs its certificate reader. A refreshed scan of four live API pages covering 370 open PR bodies found no matching fix; Discussion and sparse local overlap coverage was partial.

## Validation

Validation on native Windows, CPython 3.12.10:

- `python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_helper_allocation.py' -v`: 9 tests pass.
- The same suite with `python -I -O -B`: 9 tests pass.
- New real-CLI round trips cover two and 512 simultaneous maximum-width helpers, including certificate equality and hashes. Both subcases fail on the original reader.
- Rejection controls cover a false peak bound, oversized positive/negative aggregate values, a 1,001-digit token, and an over-limit input width.
- `python -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py`: `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`; `git diff --check` passes. Test temporary files used a workspace-local TEMP/TMP directory.

No full scientific replay or full repository test suite was run; the selected-baseline check verifies bindings only.

## Credit

Credit Ali Romman's PR #5763 and its retained PR #2655/#5717 predecessors. Prepared for josecarlosgonzalezroque-design with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Existing source licenses and predecessor attribution are retained.

## Open next questions

The smallest useful follow-up is independent replay of the two-helper and 512-helper regression cases on hosted CI. No new research package or broader research claim is proposed.
